message.body:
Added isDatatypeIri(iri) Helper: Accurately detects built-in XML Schema datatypes (such as xsd:decimal, xsd:string, xsd:integer, etc.) as well as built-in XML Schema-derived, RDF, and OWL datatypes (like rdf:HTML or owl:rational).

Datatype Core Enforcement in ensureClassExists: When creating class nodes, standard datatype IRIs are forced to be categorised as rdfs:Datatype. If an existing entity was first registered as a class, we dynamically update its classification to a datatype node.

Implicit Datatype Property Typification: In the initial mapping loop, properties containing a range IRI classified under isDatatypeIri are implicitly designated as an owl:datatypeProperty even if they were not explicitly flagged in the OWL XML definition.

Resolution Range Constraints: For all property ranges defined under owl:datatypeProperty, we explicitly register the range as rdfs:Datatype instead of defaulting to owl:Class. This triggers VOWL's virtual datatype node creation in downstream processing.

message.body:
True Fragment Handling for rdf:ID: Updated getAbout(el) to explicitly check if an identifier originates from rdf:ID. If it does, we guarantee it is resolved as a fragment (#identifier) so that it appends correctly to the base IRI even when the base IRI terminates with a slash (/).

Recursive Subject Parsing: Replaced the simple rootChildren traversal with a recursive XML graph parser (parseSubject). This ensures that inline-nested property declarations (such as <owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:ID="seconds"/> within restrictions) are correctly parsed, type-inferred, and registered under subjects even when they do not sit at the root level of the RDF document.

Robust Inline Property Extraction: Added the getPropertyIriFromOnProperty helper to retrieve the property IRI from <owl:onProperty> nodes by dynamically falling back to child nodes when the attribute is not declared directly on the element.

Restriction Datatype Virtualisation: Implemented createVirtualDatatype to generate distinct virtual datatype nodes per reference inside restriction declarations (e.g., allValuesFrom), matching the Java converter's visual representation in VOWL diagrams rather than mapping them to a single shared datatype node.

True Fragment Handling for rdf:ID: Updated getAbout(el) to explicitly check if an identifier originates from rdf:ID. If it does, we guarantee it is resolved as a fragment (#identifier) so that it appends correctly to the base IRI even when the base IRI terminates with a slash (/).

Recursive Subject Parsing: Replaced the simple rootChildren traversal with a recursive XML graph parser (parseSubject). This ensures that inline-nested property declarations (such as <owl:DatatypeProperty rdf:ID="seconds"/> within restrictions) are correctly parsed, type-inferred, and registered under subjects even when they do not sit at the root level of the RDF document.

Robust Inline Property Extraction: Added the getPropertyIriFromOnProperty helper to retrieve the property IRI from <owl:onProperty> nodes by dynamically falling back to child nodes when the attribute is not declared directly on the element.

Restriction Datatype Virtualisation: Implemented createVirtualDatatype to generate distinct virtual datatype nodes per reference inside restriction declarations (e.g., allValuesFrom), matching the Java converter's visual representation in VOWL diagrams rather than mapping them to a single shared datatype node.

message.body:
- Unified Execution Context (VowlParserContext): All shared state (Id allocation, Class, Property, Datatype, and Individual Maps) is cleanly encapsulated in a single context. This avoids variable leaking and organizes state transformations into modular stages.
- $O(d)$ Child-Iterator Optimization for OWL Restrictions: The previous implementation performed up to seven deep recursive subtree traversals per <owl:Restriction> block using getElementsByLocalName. I replaced this with an optimized, single-pass child-node scanner. By inspecting immediate children in a linear $O(d)$ sweep, deep XML subtree scans are completely bypassed.
- High-Performance IRI Cache: Since complex ontologies repetitively resolve the same base and fragment IRIs thousands of times, I implemented a fast internal look-up map (IriResolverCache). This eliminates expensive regex and string-slice overheads on hot code paths.
- Optimized Signature Inference & Sets Lookup: Replaced linear lookup operations (.includes(), .filter(), and nested loops) with $O(1)$ Set structures for entity classifications, dramatically improving processing times for deeply nested taxologies.

e.g. When elements of the imported ontology (which uses relative rdf:ID tags, e.g., <owl:Class rdf:ID="DateTimeInterval">) were imported and merged into the main universal-core.owl document, they lost their original document context (xml:base="http://www.w3.org/2006/time").
Consequently, when owl2vowl.js parsed these merged elements, the single-instance PerformanceIriResolver resolved the relative rdf:ID against the main ontology's base URI (https://haddenindustries.com/ontology/universal/core/), turning DateTimeInterval into https://haddenindustries.com/ontology/universal/core/#DateTimeInterval.

- Add a helper function getActiveBaseUri(element). When parsing an XML node, this utility traverses up the DOM ancestor tree from the node to find the closest active xml:base scope.
- Modify PerformanceIriResolver.resolve(iri, baseIri) to accept an optional baseIri context and cache resolution keys scoped by active bases
- Update all parsing paths (subjects, types, domains, ranges, restriction subproperties, and union members) inside parseSubject to pass the element's local active base

message.body:
e.g.
* Inconsistent Range Resolution (Step 3 vs Step 4)
- In owl2vowl.js, property range resolutions occur in Step 3, while restriction range resolutions occur in Step 4.
- Step 4 was correctly checking if the range IRI was a datatype using isDatatypeIri(rest.rangeIri).
- Step 3 was only checking cls && cls.type === "rdfs:Datatype". If a standard datatype IRI (like xsd:dateTimeStamp) was not explicitly declared as a subject node (which is typical for basic XMLSchema types), it was absent from classMap. Step 3 therefore fell back to assigning owl:Thing (or ID "0") as the range, leaving the virtual datatype node unlinked.

* Overwritten Fallback Labels
- The datatype node was indeed parsed from the nested <rdf:Description>, but it only had a Spanish label (xml:lang="es").
- In the subjects mapping loop, if any localized labels were found, they completely overwrote the default "undefined" label (which initially held the local name fallback, e.g. dateTimeStamp).
- Consequently, the UI was left with no fallback name to render on the canvas when running in English/default mode.

owl2vowl.js:
- Modify Step 3 of to match Step 4's range checking to ensure that a virtual datatype node is generated and correctly mapped as the property's range for all datatype properties, linking it properly to the domain class (e.g., http://www.w3.org/2006/time#Instant)
- Update the mapping logic for classes, datatypes, properties, and individuals. If localized labels are present but a default "undefined" label is missing, the converter now injects the local name segment of the IRI as the "undefined" label fallback to ensure that localized entities are never drawn blank or "without Name" on the canvas

message.body:
### A. Add DTD Entity Preprocessor (`xmlUtils.js`)
* **Purpose**: Allows standard JavaScript DOM parser engines (in both Node.js and browser environments) to parse ontologies containing DTD entity placeholders (like `wine.rdf` which uses `&vin;`, `&xsd;`, and `&food;`) without breaking or requiring local configuration mappings.
* **Security**: Safe from XML External Entity (XXE) attacks because it performs a purely local string regex mapping and resolution process inside the client sandbox, preventing any network requests or arbitrary filesystem reads.
* **Integrations**: Integrated into both the synchronous parser (`index.js`) and the asynchronous recursive loader (`importLoader.js`).

### B. Improve Multiple `owl:Thing` Nodes Layout
* **Purpose**: Prevents the visual "owl:Thing hairball" in WebVOWL when multiple unrelated properties lack explicit domain/range declarations.
* **Mechanism**: Implemented a **free-thing recycling logic** in `ontologyConverter.js` that mirrors Java's `VowlThingProvider.isFree`, `getDisconnectedThing`, and `generateThing` methods with two distinct strategies:
  - **Both Domain & Range Empty**: Reuses the shared free `owl:Thing` node pool (such as `skos:broadMatch` and `skos:mappingRelation` sharing the default `owl:Thing` ID `0`), preserving layout consistency.
  - **Only One Empty**: Generates a dedicated new virtual `owl:Thing` node (or reuses one already connected to that specific domain/range node) to isolate the property and prevent it from polluting the unconstrained pool (e.g. preventing `skos:inScheme`'s domain from locking down ID `0`).
* **Serialization**: Updated `jsonExporter.js` to serialize `virtualThings` alongside standard ontologies.

message.body:
* The Rule
When two entities are declared equivalent, Java breaks circular references and duplicate links using specific namespace rules:
- If an entity namespace is external to the base ontology and it is equivalent to an internal entity, the external entity has its equivalent class references list cleared (so only the internal class lists the external class as equivalent).
- Sorting is performed on equivalent lists to guarantee the base ontology IRI takes priority.

* The Issue
The JS implementation accepts all equivalent relations verbatim from the parsed RDF classes/properties. This causes redundant, circular, and duplicate equivalence definitions on imported/external namespaces.

* The Solution
Port the exact namespace check and cycle-breaking rules into a JS helper getSortedEquivalents in ontologyConverter.js, applied to both class and property equivalence paths

message.body:
User Experience Changes:
  - Refresh one part of the environment on its own, without
    reinstalling everything
  - Declare the authoring skills in one place, so adding or removing
    one needs no matching change to the setup code
  - Report a leftover skill as a failure rather than leaving it
    installed and unnoticed

File Changes:
  1. `.gitignore`
     - Add exclusions for the local development environment
  2. `scripts/_commands.py`
     - Add the external-command runner, executable lookup, and the
       shared `SetupError`, as the leaf of the dependency graph
  3. `scripts/_repository.py`
     - Add repository-root derivation, remote-identity verification,
       and the tracked/ignored queries used before deleting anything
     - Derive the root by position and let Git confirm it, so no
       script depends on the name of the directory holding it
  4. `scripts/set_up_agent_skills.py`
     - Drive the skill refresh from `skills-lock.json` instead of a
       hardcoded list of sources and an expected-name list
     - Group skills by install source so one source is cloned once
     - Force LF checkouts through process-local Git config, keeping
       the lock's hashes stable across platforms
     - Require each generated root to be ignored, not merely
       untracked, before rebuilding it
     - Verify each root holds exactly the declared skills
     - Vendor a sibling `../_shared` directory into the installed
       skill through a sparse checkout of only what it needs
  5. `scripts/set_up_mcp_servers.py`
     - Add GitHub MCP server installation and host configuration

- HTML Structure & Landmarks (src/index.html):
  * Restrict <main> landmark to wrap only #canvasArea.
  * Move #menuContainer, #swipeBarContainer, and <aside id="detailsArea">
    outside of <main>.
  * Convert menu containers from <div> to <nav id="menuContainer"> and
    <nav id="swipeBarContainer">.
  * Convert sidebar headers (#editHeader, #title) from <h1> to <h2> to
    preserve a single <h1> document root.
  * Replace non-interactive clickable elements (#killWarning,
    #show-loadingInfo-button, #loadingIndicator_closeButton,
    #leftSideBarCollapseButton, #sidebarExpandButton, #centerGraphButton,
    #zoomInButton, #zoomOutButton) with <button type="button"> elements.
  * Add <label class="sr-only"> utility elements for #search-input-text,
    #descriptionEditor, and #directInputTextArea.
  * Add aria-hidden="true" to decorative icon SVGs.
  * Extract inline style="..." attributes to toolstyle.css and remove
    deprecated align="center" from #containerForAddPrefixButton.

- CSS Reset & Layout Fixes (src/app/css/toolstyle.css):
  * Add .sr-only utility class for screen-reader-only labels.
  * Add <button> reset rules and set width: 100%, display: block, and
    box-sizing: border-box for zoom controls (#centerGraphButton,
    #zoomInButton, #zoomOutButton) to match #zoomSlider container bounds.
  * Update #zoomSlider > p:hover selector to include #zoomSlider > button:hover
    to retain hover background highlights (#d90).
  * Add line-height: 20px and display: block for 24x24px sidebar expand
    and collapse buttons (#leftSideBarCollapseButton, #sidebarExpandButton).
  * Add display: block, width: 100%, box-sizing: border-box to
    #show-loadingInfo-button and display: inline-block to
    #loadingIndicator_closeButton.
  * Update #WarningErrorMessages label and #editorHint label selectors
    (and hover rules) to include button elements.
  * Update #detailsArea h1 selector to #detailsArea h1, #detailsArea h2.

- JavaScript Modules & Accessibility (src/app/js/):
  * warningModule.js: Convert .append("label") calls to .append("button")
    with type="button" for killWarningErrorMessages_*, cancelButton_*,
    zoomElementThing_*, and showElementThing_*, eliminating unassociated
    <label> browser warnings.
  * modeMenu.js: Convert .append("label") for (experimental) text suffix to
    .append("span") under #editMode > div.
  * sidebar.js: Ensure startup accordion collapse initialization
    collapseContainers(d3.selectAll(".accordion-trigger:not(.accordion-trigger-active) + div"))
    runs to collapse inactive panels on page load.
  * sidebar.js, editSidebar.js, leftSidebar.js: Add tabindex="0",
    role="button", and keydown listeners using d3.event || window.event for
    D3 v3 event compatibility across accordion triggers.

- Packaging (Gruntfile.js):
  * Gruntfile.js: Include favicon.svg in static asset copy task alongside
    favicon.ico.

- Tested & Reverted Approaches:
  * Deferred Script Loading: Retained scripts at bottom of <body>; moving
    scripts to <head> with defer caused ReferenceError because HTML5 spec
    ignores defer on inline script tags without src attributes.
  * Custom Zoom Button Key Listeners: Native <button type="button"> elements
    handle Enter/Space keypresses natively via click events; custom listeners
    were redundant and threw TypeError under D3 v3 event scope.

message.body:
Update ontology language resolution in the sidebar to automatically set the initial graph language using the browser's preferred language (`navigator.language` / `navigator.languages`).

- Implement BCP 47 language matching algorithm in `sidebar.js`:
  - Phase 1: Case-insensitive exact match against browser language preferences.
  - Phase 2: Primary language tag match (e.g. `de-DE` matching `de` or `de` matching `de-DE`).
  - Phase 3: Fallback to English (`en` / `en-*`).
  - Phase 4: Fallback to `LANG_UNDEFINED` (`undefined`).
  - Phase 5: Fallback to `LANG_IRIBASED` (`id`).
  - Phase 6: Fallback to the first available language in the ontology.
- Re-order timing in `sidebar.updateOntologyInformation(...)` to call `setLanguages(...)` first, ensuring `graph.language()` is updated prior to rendering sidebar title/description metadata and canvas node/property labels.
- Add unit tests in `src/app/js/languageSelection.test.js` to verify resolution logic across regional, base tag, and fallback scenarios.

message.body:
Comprehensive UI/UX refactoring, mobile PWA meta additions, layout standardization, SVG icon modernization, and defensive bug fixes across WebVOWL:

1. Mobile Web App PWA & Meta Enhancements (index.html):
   - Added viewport-fit=cover to the viewport meta tag for modern edge-to-edge mobile display.
   - Added <meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">, <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">, and <meta name="theme-color" content="#18202A">.
   - Defined reusable <g id="crosshair-symbol"> SVG symbol in #drag_svg defs.
   - Updated copyright date range in #m_about from 2014-2019 to 2014-2026.

2. Navigation Bar Standardization & CSS Flexbox Pipeline (toolstyle.css, index.html, app.js):
   - Standardized #swipeBarContainer, #menuElementContainer, #menuElementContainer > li, #menuElementContainer > li > a, #scrollRightButton, and #scrollLeftButton to a uniform 44px height across all desktop and mobile viewports.
   - Replaced legacy padding hacks (padding: 12px 0 0, padding: 9px 12px 12px 30px, top: 10px, top: 5px) with a unified CSS Flexbox pipeline (display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;), aligning all menu entries, SVG icons, text labels, search input, and scroll buttons to the exact 22px vertical midpoint.
   - Updated canvas height calculation in app.js adjustSize() to window.innerHeight - 44 to fill the viewport cleanly down to the 44px bottom bar.
   - Removed legacy inline style="padding: 9px 8px 12px 8px;" from #pause-button in index.html for 100% vertical flex centering.

3. Ground-Up #zoomSlider Rewrite & Range Control Cleanup (index.html, toolstyle.css, app.js):
   - Restructured #zoomSlider HTML into a vertical flex column: #centerGraphButton (with SVG crosshair) -> #zoomInButton (with SVG +) -> <div id="zoomSliderParagraph"> -> #zoomOutButton (with SVG -). Added aria-label attributes to all zoom controls.
   - Set #zoomSlider base rule to bottom: 60px !important; in toolstyle.css to guarantee a uniform 16px clearance gap above #swipeBarContainer across all viewports.
   - Removed explicit width/height declarations from #zoomSliderElement so it fluidly scales to fill #zoomSliderParagraph via position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-90deg);.
   - Completely purged legacy -webkit-transform-origin-x: 73px rules and custom track/thumb pseudo-elements (::-webkit-slider-thumb, ::-moz-range-thumb, etc.) to revert to browser-native range control rendering.
   - Retained .slideOption input[type="range"] { width: 100%; } in toolstyle.css so horizontal option sliders in sidebar panels span container width correctly.
   - Simplified adjustSliderSize() in app.js to delegate vertical layout to CSS Flexbox while handling hidden state when viewport height is too small.

4. Dynamic DOM Bounds Sidebar Offset & Mobile Drawer Logic (sidebar.js):
   - Updated updateSidebarButtonPosition() and updateZoomSliderPosition() to calculate horizontal left positions dynamically via detailArea.node().getBoundingClientRect().left.
   - Positioned #sidebarExpandButton at a fixed 12px offset left of the sidebar's leftmost edge, and #zoomSlider at a set 20px offset left of the sidebar edge when expanded.
   - Added updateNavMenuScrollButtons() and hideNavMenus() helper functions in sidebar.js to replace direct calls to graph.options().navigationMenu().
   - Added auto-collapse logic on small screens (if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) sidebar.showSidebar(0, true)).

5. Search Component Modernization & Null-Safety Hardening (index.html, toolstyle.css, graph.js):
   - Replaced unicode character in #locateSearchResult with WebVOWL's native 24x24 filled crosshair SVG path (d="M11 2h2v3.06..."), matching c_select and zoom control icon styling 1:1.
   - Positioned i.searchIcon on the left side inside li#c_search input.searchInputText via position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%) with 30px padding-left on the input field.
   - Enforced position: static !important on #locateSearchResult i and .menuElementSvgElement to lock icon position during hover state changes.
   - Added defensive guard checks in graph.resetSearchHighlight() and graph.highLightNodes() (if (!unfilteredData || !unfilteredData.nodes || !unfilteredData.properties) return;) to prevent uncaught TypeError exceptions when searching before graph data is loaded.

6. Menu Interaction & Timer Bug Fixes (navigationMenu.js, configMenu.js):
   - Fixed timer variable typo in navigationMenu.js (t_scrollLeft = requestAnimationFrame(timed_scrollLeft)) that broke scrollLeftButton interactivity after screen resize.
   - Bound global window.on("resize.navMenu") and window mouseup/touchend handlers to re-evaluate scroll boundaries and release animation loops when releasing pointer anywhere on screen.
   - Added direct 100px step click handlers to #scrollLeftButton and #scrollRightButton.
   - Updated configMenu.js setCheckBoxValue to execute onChangeFunc silently when programmatically updating checkbox states.

message.body:
Replace the legacy Grunt and Webpack build pipeline with Vite 6. This upgrade removes 21 outdated build dependencies while preserving output structure, version string injection, static asset distribution, and environment-specific behaviors.

Detailed changes:

- vite.config.js (NEW):
  * Set Vite root to src/ and output directory to deploy/.
  * Integrated vite-plugin-commonjs to transform CommonJS modules (require/module.exports).
  * Implemented d3ProvidePlugin to inject var d3 = window.d3 at module scope, eliminating window property lookups inside high-frequency D3 force layout rendering loops (60 FPS).
  * Externalized D3 (rollupOptions.external: ["d3"]).
  * Added @rollup/plugin-replace for @@WEBVOWL_VERSION string substitution.
  * Configured vite-plugin-static-copy to distribute datasets (src/app/data/*), favicons, license, and d3.min.js to deploy/.
  * Added custom webvowlBuildPlugin for HTML template version replacement (__WEBVOWL_VERSION__), comment marker stripping (<!-- build:process -->, <!-- build:remove release-->), and production release cleanup of benchmark.json.
  * Set fixed unhashed output filenames (js/[name].js, css/[name].[ext]).
  * Added mtime-preserve plugin using fs.utimesSync in closeBundle to preserve original file modified timestamps when content is unchanged.
  * Targeted es2022 with fast esbuild JS and CSS minification (legalComments: "none").

- src/main.js (NEW):
  * Unified ES module entry point importing webvowl and app libraries, assigning window.webvowl and webvowl.app, and invoking webvowl.app().initialize() on window load.

- util/zip.js (NEW):
  * Standalone Node CommonJS script replacing grunt-contrib-compress. Automatically retrieves git branch and short SHA, sanitizes branch names containing slashes, and packages deploy/ into webvowl-[branch]-[sha].zip.

- Gruntfile.js & webpack.config.js (DELETED):
  * Removed legacy Grunt orchestrator and Webpack bundler configurations.

- package.json & package-lock.json:
  * Removed 21 legacy Grunt and Webpack devDependencies.
  * Added vite, vite-plugin-commonjs, @rollup/plugin-replace, vite-plugin-static-copy, vite-plugin-eslint2, terser, and archiver.
  * Removed obsolete overrides section.
  * Updated npm scripts: dev, build, release, preview, test, zip, webserver.

- src/index.html:
  * Removed manual CSS link tags (now imported transitively via JS).
  * Added <script src="/js/d3.min.js"></script> and <script type="module" src="/main.js"></script>.
  * Replaced <%= version %> with __WEBVOWL_VERSION__ for parse5 HTML parsing compatibility.

- src/owl2vowl/js/index.js, src/app/js/directInputModule.js, src/app/js/loadingModule.js:
  * Attached loadWithImports and catalog directly onto the owl2vowl function object before exporting.
  * Added safe interop fallbacks (owl2vowlModule.default || owl2vowlModule) in directInputModule.js and loadingModule.js to ensure owl2vowl is never undefined across ESM/CommonJS boundaries.

- src/app/js/languageSelection.test.js:
  * Removed redundant @jest/globals import in CommonJS test file to prevent V8 SyntaxError.

- Dockerfile & .travis.yml:
  * Upgraded Docker NODE_IMAGE from 12-alpine to 22-alpine. Updated COPY directives to copy vite.config.js, eslint.config.js, and LICENSE.
  * Updated Travis CI matrix to Node 22, removed grunt-cli installation, and updated linter command to npx eslint src/.

  * Added custom webvowlBuildPlugin for HTML template version replacement (__WEBVOWL_VERSION__), comment marker stripping (<!-- build:process -->, <!-- build:remove release-->), and production release cleanup of benchmark.json.

  * Added mtime-preserve plugin using fs.utimesSync in closeBundle to preserve original file modified timestamps when content is unchanged.
  * Targeted es2022 with fast esbuild JS and CSS minification (legalComments: "none").

- src/main.js (NEW):
  * Unified ES module entry point importing webvowl and app libraries, assigning window.webvowl and webvowl.app, and invoking webvowl.app().initialize() on window load.

- util/zip.js (NEW):
  * Standalone Node CommonJS script replacing grunt-contrib-compress. Automatically retrieves git branch and short SHA, sanitizes branch names containing slashes, and packages deploy/ into webvowl-[branch]-[sha].zip.

- Gruntfile.js & webpack.config.js (DELETED):
  * Removed legacy Grunt orchestrator and Webpack bundler configurations.

- package.json & package-lock.json:
  * Removed 21 legacy Grunt and Webpack devDependencies.
  * Added vite, vite-plugin-commonjs, @rollup/plugin-replace, vite-plugin-static-copy, vite-plugin-eslint2, terser, and archiver.
  * Removed obsolete overrides section.
  * Updated npm scripts: dev, build, release, preview, test, zip, webserver.

- src/index.html:
  * Removed manual CSS link tags (now imported transitively via JS).
  * Added <script src="/js/d3.min.js"></script> and <script type="module" src="/main.js"></script>.
  * Replaced <%= version %> with __WEBVOWL_VERSION__ for parse5 HTML parsing compatibility.

- src/owl2vowl/js/index.js, src/app/js/directInputModule.js, src/app/js/loadingModule.js:
  * Attached loadWithImports and catalog directly onto the owl2vowl function object before exporting.
  * Added safe interop fallbacks (owl2vowlModule.default || owl2vowlModule) in directInputModule.js and loadingModule.js to ensure owl2vowl is never undefined across ESM/CommonJS boundaries.

- src/app/js/languageSelection.test.js:
  * Removed redundant @jest/globals import in CommonJS test file to prevent V8 SyntaxError.

- Dockerfile & .travis.yml:
  * Upgraded Docker NODE_IMAGE from 12-alpine to 22-alpine. Updated COPY directives to copy vite.config.js, eslint.config.js, and LICENSE.
  * Updated Travis CI matrix to Node 22, removed grunt-cli installation, and updated linter command to npx eslint src/.

message.body:
Prevent sidebars from occluding the bottom navigation taskbar, unify docked control positioning, remove legacy JS taskbar width mutations, and resolve dropdown tooltip clipping against the right sidebar.

Detailed changes:

- src/app/css/toolstyle.css:
  * Updated base `#detailsArea` selector with `bottom: 44px` and `height: calc(100% - 44px)` so the right sidebar always docks above the 44px bottom navigation bar (`#swipeBarContainer`).
  * Rationalised `@media screen and (width <= 1024px)` by removing redundant base property overrides (`position`, `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `height`, `background-color`, `border-left`).
  * Removed `width: 90vw; max-width: 100vw;` override from `@media screen and (width <= 768px)` so `#detailsArea` maintains `width: 320px; max-width: 85vw;` on mobile viewports without obscuring the canvas.
  * Removed deprecated CSS Media Queries Level 4 `device-width` and `device-height` queries.
  * Updated `#scrollLeftButton` and `#scrollRightButton` with `position: fixed; bottom: 0; z-index: 1200; height: 44px; width: 44px;` so scroll indicator buttons render on top of the taskbar (`z-index: 1100`).

- src/app/js/sidebar.js:
  * Unified `updateZoomSliderPosition` and `updateSidebarButtonPosition` directly into `sidebar.updateDockedControlsPosition` with a standardized `12px` gap offset (`DOCKED_CONTROL_OFFSET`).
  * Removed legacy `menuArea` (`#swipeBarContainer`) DOM selection and inline style width mutations from `showSidebar()`, allowing `#swipeBarContainer` to rely 100% on its CSS stylesheet rules (`width: 100%`).

- src/app/js/app.js:
  * Updated `adjustSize()` to invoke `sidebar.updateDockedControlsPosition()` directly during window resize events.

- src/app/js/menu/navigationMenu.js:
  * Updated `updateMenuPosition()` to evaluate `maxRightBoundary` as `Math.min(windowWidth, sidebarLeft)` when `#detailsArea` is open, shifting `.toolTipMenu` popups left to align flush against `#detailsArea` and prevent occlusion.
  * Added `updateMenuPosition()` call to `resize.navMenu` window resize listener.

message.body:
### User Experience (UX) Improvements
- **Touch Screen & Mobile Selection**:
  - Tapping nodes or property labels on touch screens now reliably selects them and displays their details in the sidebar.
  - Resolved property tap issues where properties would immediately deselect themselves or fail to select when toggled after a node.
  - Double-tap inline text editing now functions smoothly without single-tap false positives.
  - Eliminated false touch-device detection on desktop Chrome browsers to preserve standard desktop controls.
  - Top navigation menus now auto-dismiss when tapping outside on touch devices and can be repeatedly opened without sticking.
- **Enhanced Zoom Slider Control**:
  - Expanded the touch hit area of the zoom slider to fill the entire container box (scaling responsively up to 44px on mobile/tablet viewports).
  - Unset fixed width constraints on `#zoomSliderElement` to eliminate slider clipping issues.
  - Tapping or dragging anywhere along the zoom slider track now smoothly adjusts the canvas zoom level.
- **Simulation Pause & Node Pinned State**:
  - Pausing the simulation via the "Pause" menu now reliably freezes physics calculations and node movements.
  - Fixed node pinning so dragged nodes stay pinned at their exact release location when locked.
- **Visualization Progress Bar**:
  - Corrected the "Generating Visualisation" progress bar calculation to smoothly animate from 0% to 100% instead of starting at a negative percentage.
- **Warning Popups & Dialog Dismissal**:
  - Tapping "Got It" or "Cancel" on warning dialogs (e.g. "Collapsing filter activated") now cleanly collapses and dismisses messages without JavaScript errors.
  - Cleaned up extraneous debug logs from the browser console.

---

### Comprehensive File-by-File Net Diff Details

1. `eslint.config.js`:
   - Added `Map`, `Set`, and `fetch` as readonly globals under `languageOptions.globals` to allow ES6 collections and native fetch API without linter errors.

2. `package.json`:
   - Updated `"d3"` dependency version from `"^3.5.6"` to `"^7.9.0"`.

3. `package-lock.json`:
   - Updated lockfile entries for `d3` v7.9.0 and its sub-dependencies (`d3-array`, `d3-axis`, `d3-brush`, `d3-chord`, `d3-color`, `d3-dispatch`, `d3-drag`, `d3-dsv`, `d3-ease`, `d3-fetch`, `d3-force`, `d3-format`, `d3-hierarchy`, `d3-interpolate`, `d3-path`, `d3-polygon`, `d3-quadtree`, `d3-random`, `d3-scale`, `d3-scale-chromatic`, `d3-selection`, `d3-shape`, `d3-time`, `d3-time-format`, `d3-timer`, `d3-transition`, `d3-zoom`).

4. `src/app/css/toolstyle.css`:
   - Updated `#zoomSliderParagraph`: set `width: 36px`, `touch-action: none`.
   - Updated `#zoomSliderElement`: set `position: absolute`, `top: 50%`, `left: 50%`, `height: 100%`, `transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-90deg)`, `touch-action: none`, `appearance: none`, `background: transparent`, removing fixed `width: 140px;`.
   - Added range track styles (`::-webkit-slider-runnable-track`, `::-moz-range-track`) with `width: 100%`, `height: 6px`, `background: #ddd`, `border-radius: 3px`.
   - Added range thumb styles (`::-webkit-slider-thumb`, `::-moz-range-thumb`) with `width: 24px`, `height: 24px`, `border-radius: 50%`, `background: #2b5797`, `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%)`.
   - Updated `@media screen and (width <= 1024px)` rule: added `#zoomSliderElement { height: 44px; }` alongside `#zoomSliderParagraph { width: 44px; }`.

5. `src/app/js/app.js`:
   - Updated `isTouchDevice()`: removed legacy `document.createEvent("TouchEvent")` fallback to prevent desktop Chrome browsers from being falsely detected as touch devices.
   - Updated window resize listener `adjustSize` to accept `event` parameter.
   - Updated document keydown listener signature `(event)`.
   - Updated `direct-text-input` and `reloadSvgIcon` event listeners.

6. `src/app/js/browserWarning.js`:
   - Removed debug `console.log("Browser Version =" + version);` statement from `showBrowserWarningIfRequired()`.
   - Removed debug `console.log("hide the warning please");` statement from `killWarning` click listener.

7. `src/app/js/editSidebar.js`:
   - Updated `enablePrefixEdit(item)`: checked `if (item && !(item instanceof Event) && item.id)` to prevent `MouseEvent` from overwriting `agent` and causing `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'split')`.
   - Updated `deletePrefixLine()` to read `this.id.split("_")[1]`.
   - Updated accordion keyboard listener `triggers.on("keydown", function(event)` and click listener `triggers.on("click", function()`.
   - Updated input change and keydown listeners across IRI, datatype, and label editing fields to accept explicit `event` parameters.
   - Updated `handleCheckBoxClick()` for node/property characteristics checkboxes.

8. `src/app/js/leftSidebar.js`:
   - Updated accordion keydown listener signature `(event)`.
   - Updated `classSelectorFunction()`, `datatypeSelectorFunction()`, and `propertySelectorFunction()` element selection functions.

9. `src/app/js/loadingModule.js`:
   - Replaced 5 legacy `d3.json()` / `d3.xhr()` network calls with native `fetch()` promises in `loadingModule.loadFromUrl()`, `loadFromJSON()`, `loadFromIRI()`, and `convertIRI()`.

10. `src/app/js/menu/configMenu.js`:
    - Updated `configCheckbox.on("click", function(event, datum)` signature for D3 v7 callback parameters.
    - Updated programmatic click dispatch `silent` argument checking.

11. `src/app/js/menu/debugMenu.js`:
    - Updated `configCheckbox.on("click", function(event, datum)` signature.

12. `src/app/js/menu/exportMenu.js`:
    - Updated `exportSvg()`, `exportJson(event)`, `exportTex(event)`, `exportTurtle(event)`, and `copyUrl()` click handler signatures.

13. `src/app/js/menu/filterMenu.js`:
    - Updated `filterCheckbox.on("click", function(event, datum)` callback signature and programmatic click parameters.

14. `src/app/js/menu/gravityMenu.js`:
    - Updated gravity slider and checkbox `.on("change", function(event)` and `.on("click", function(event, datum)` signatures.

15. `src/app/js/menu/modeMenu.js`:
    - Updated `moduleCheckbox.on("click", function(event, datum)` signature for compact notation, editor mode, and color externals toggles.

16. `src/app/js/menu/navigationMenu.js`:
    - Added automatic 400ms/500ms timer resetting for `touchedElement = false` in `menuElementClicked()` and `menuElementTouched()`.
    - Added `touchstart` dismiss listeners on `#graph` and `#generalDetails` to close open menus when tapping outside on touch devices.

17. `src/app/js/menu/ontologyMenu.js`:
    - Replaced 7 legacy `d3.json()` / `d3.xhr()` network calls with native `fetch()` promises across ontology loading, converter status checks, and sample file loading.
    - Updated `ontologySelection.on("click", function(event)` signature.

18. `src/app/js/menu/pauseMenu.js`:
    - Updated `pause-button` click listener to accept `event` parameter.

19. `src/app/js/menu/searchMenu.js`:
    - Updated `searchLineEdit.on("click", toggleSearchEntryView)` and `c_locate.on("click", function(event)` signatures.

20. `src/app/js/menu/zoomSlider.js`:
    - Added `handleContainerTouch(event)` function and registered `touchstart` and `touchmove` listeners on `#zoomSliderParagraph` to allow tapping/dragging anywhere on the container to set zoom level.

21. `src/app/js/sidebar.js`:
    - Updated sidebar collapse button click listener and accordion `triggers.on("click", function())` signatures.

22. `src/app/js/warningModule.js`:
    - Updated `warningModule.closeMessage = function(id)`: checked `typeof id === "string"` and `typeof id === "number"`, falling back to `this.id` when called as a D3 v7 event listener (`gotItButton.on("click", warningModule.closeMessage)`), preventing `TypeError: id.indexOf is not a function`.
    - Removed debug `console.log(document.styleSheets)` statement.

23. `src/webvowl/js/classDragger.js`:
    - Updated `d3.svg.line().interpolate("cardinal")` to `d3.line().curve(d3.curveCardinal)`.

24. `src/webvowl/js/elements/drawTools.js`:
    - Updated transition `.ease('linear')` to `.ease(d3.easeLinear)` and `.each("end")` to `.on("end")`.
    - Updated callback signatures replacing `d3.event` with `event`.

25. `src/webvowl/js/elements/forceLayoutNodeFunctions.js`:
    - Updated `applyFixedLocationAttributes()` to set `node.fx = node.x; node.fy = node.y;` when locked, frozen, or pinned, and clear them (`fx = null, fy = null`) when free.

26. `src/webvowl/js/elements/links/Label.js`:
    - Added `fx` and `fy` getter and setter property definitions forwarding coordinate fixation from underlying property to label edge node.

27. `src/webvowl/js/elements/nodes/BaseNode.js`:
    - Replaced `d3.event` references with `event` argument in node click, drag, and double-tap listeners.
    - Updated `.ease()` and `.on("end")` transition methods.

28. `src/webvowl/js/elements/nodes/RectangularNode.js`:
    - Replaced `d3.event` references with `event` argument.

29. `src/webvowl/js/elements/nodes/nodeMap.js`:
    - Replaced `d3.map()` constructor with native `Map`.

30. `src/webvowl/js/elements/properties/BaseProperty.js`:
    - Replaced `d3.event` references with `event` argument.
    - Updated transition `.ease()` and `.on("end")` syntax.

31. `src/webvowl/js/elements/properties/propertyMap.js`:
    - Replaced `d3.map()` constructor with native `Map`.

32. `src/webvowl/js/entry.js`:
    - Updated `nodeMap` and `propertyMap` iterations from `d3.map.entries()` objects to native `Map.forEach((value, key) => ...)`.

33. `src/webvowl/js/graph.js`:

refactor(d3): upgrade dependency to D3 v7.9.0 and optimize mobile/touch UI

### User Experience (UX) Improvements
- **Touch Screen & Mobile Selection**:
  - Tapping nodes or property labels on touch screens now reliably selects them and displays their details in the sidebar.
  - Resolved property tap issues where properties would immediately deselect themselves or fail to select when toggled after a node.
  - Double-tap inline text editing now functions smoothly without single-tap false positives.
  - Eliminated false touch-device detection on desktop Chrome browsers to preserve standard desktop controls.
  - Top navigation menus now auto-dismiss when tapping outside on touch devices and can be repeatedly opened without sticking.
- **Enhanced Zoom Slider Control**:
  - Expanded the touch hit area of the zoom slider to fill the entire container box (scaling responsively up to 44px on mobile/tablet viewports).
  - Unset fixed width constraints on `#zoomSliderElement` to eliminate slider clipping issues.
  - Tapping or dragging anywhere along the zoom slider track now smoothly adjusts the canvas zoom level.
- **Simulation Pause & Node Pinned State**:
  - Pausing the simulation via the "Pause" menu now reliably freezes physics calculations and node movements.
  - Fixed node pinning so dragged nodes stay pinned at their exact release location when locked.
- **Visualization Progress Bar**:
  - Corrected the "Generating Visualisation" progress bar calculation to smoothly animate from 0% to 100% instead of starting at a negative percentage.
- **Warning Popups & Dialog Dismissal**:
  - Tapping "Got It" or "Cancel" on warning dialogs (e.g. "Collapsing filter activated") now cleanly collapses and dismisses messages without JavaScript errors.
  - Cleaned up extraneous debug logs from the browser console.

- Upgrade eslint.config.js to enforce strict ES2024 ES Modules rules (no-var, prefer-const, curly, no-prototype-builtins, no-console).

- Replaced direct .hasOwnProperty(...) calls with Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(...) across utilities, parsers, and sidebars for prototype pollution safety.
- Converted console.log(...) calls to console.warn(...) for controlled diagnostic output.
- Fixed non-standard control character regular expressions in ontologyMenu.js.
- Verified 0 ESLint errors/warnings, 13/13 passing test suites (87/87 tests passing), and clean Vite bundle compilation.

message.body:
When a user changes the language dropdown (#language), annotation attributes in the Selection Details pane are now dynamically filtered to match the active language setting, eliminating duplicate multi-language attribute listings.

User Experience Impact:
When selecting an element with multi-language annotations (e.g. skos:editorialNote in "en" and "es"), setting the language selector to "en" will now render only the "en" annotation entry in the Selection Details pane rather than displaying entries for all languages simultaneously. Changing the language selector immediately updates the displayed annotations to match the newly selected language.

src/app/js/languageSelection.test.js
- Implement isLanguageMatch and filterAnnotationItems unit test helpers.
- Add unit test suite "selection details annotation attribute language filtering" verifying exact language filtering, derivative tag matching (e.g. "en-GB" matching "en"), retention of universal/IRI/undefined annotations, and English fallback logic.

src/app/js/sidebar.js
- Implement isLanguageMatch helper function for case-insensitive exact and primary subtag language tag matching.
- Implement filterAnnotationItems helper function to separate universal/IRI annotations from language-tagged annotations, filtering language-tagged entries by the current graph language with English and universal fallbacks.
- Update listAnnotations to resolve graph.language() and filter all annotation item arrays using filterAnnotationItems prior to rendering.
- Preserve language attribute (language: entry.language) when mapping surfaced rdfs:label entries in displayPropertyInformation and displayNodeInformation so surfaced rdfs:label items are correctly filtered by language.

message.body:
User Experience Changes:
- Floating controls (#sidebarExpandButton and #zoomSlider) now slide smoothly and remain docked directly to the left edge of #detailsArea without jumping or moving out of alignment when expanding or resizing the browser window above 1024px.
- #sidebarExpandButton sits flush with the top of the screen (top: 0px) and flush against the left border of #detailsArea (right: var(--right-sidebar-width)) when open.
- Sidebar width scales gracefully on high-resolution displays (>= 1600px and >= 2100px viewports), giving more breathing room for ontology metadata and editor controls.

src\app\css\toolstyle.css
- Declare :root CSS variables --right-sidebar-width (280px), --left-sidebar-width (200px), and --control-margin (12px).
- Add responsive media queries for large viewports (>= 1600px scales --right-sidebar-width to 320px; >= 2100px scales to 360px).
- Update @keyframes sbExpandAnimation, sbCollapseAnimation, warn_ExpandRightBarAnimation, and warn_CollapseRightBarAnimation to use calc(100% - var(--right-sidebar-width)) and purge duplicate keyframe blocks.
- Update #canvasArea.sidebar-visible and #WarningErrorMessagesContainer.sidebar-visible width rules to calc(100% - var(--right-sidebar-width)).
- Update #detailsArea width to var(--right-sidebar-width) and add width transition duration matching 0.5s ease.
- Update #sidebarExpandButton CSS to top: 0px and position: fixed, resolving positioning context issues where absolute positioning inside shrinking #canvasArea caused leftward jumping.
- Update #sidebarExpandButton.aligned-to-sidebar right rule to var(--right-sidebar-width), making it flush with #detailsArea.
- Update #zoomSlider.aligned-to-sidebar right rule to calc(var(--right-sidebar-width) + var(--control-margin)), maintaining a 12px margin from #detailsArea.
- Remove hardcoded pixel width (320px) and right offset overrides (328px, 335px) from @media screen and (width <= 1024px).

src\app\js\app.js
- Add getRightSidebarWidth() helper function to read --right-sidebar-width directly from DOM computed styles.
- Update adjustSize() to subtract getRightSidebarWidth() from window.innerWidth when the sidebar is visible, replacing percentage-based width calculations.
- Update adjustSize() resize listener to trigger sidebar.updateSideBarVis(true) on window resize.

src\app\js\menu\zoomSlider.js
- Update showSlider() toggle listener to trigger graph.options().sidebar().updateDockedControlsPosition() when Zoom controls are shown or hidden.

src\app\js\sidebar.js
- Update updateDockedControlsPosition() to apply .aligned-to-sidebar class to both #zoomSlider and #sidebarExpandButton whenever detailArea is open, removing small-screen conditional checks.
- Add getRightSidebarWidth() helper function to read --right-sidebar-width directly from DOM computed styles.
- Update showSidebar() to calculate graph canvas width using getRightSidebarWidth(), enforcing consistent sidebar width behavior across all screen sizes.

message.body: User Experience Changes: - Clicking Reset now shows an immediate cyan scale-bounce and glow effect that plays concurrently with the graph reload, even on large ontologies - The "Reset" label and SVG icon remain fully white and readable throughout the animation (WCAG AA compliant) - The glow fades out smoothly after the graph reloads src/app/css/toolstyle.css - Add `position: relative` and `overflow: visible` to `.navButton.action-pill` to support the glow overlay - Scope `transition` to `background` and `border-color` only, removing `all` to avoid interfering with transform animations applied during the flash - Add `#reset-button { will-change: transform }` to pre-establish a compositor layer before any click occurs, eliminating layer-creation delay at click time - Add `@keyframes reset-flash-scale` animating only `transform: scale` (compositor-thread-safe) for the press-and-bounce feedback on the button itself - Add `.navButton.action-pill.flash-active` rule applying `reset-flash-scale` over 0.65s with spring easing - Add `.reset-glow` styles: `position: absolute`, `inset: -3px`, `background: #22d3ee`, `opacity: 0`, `will-change: opacity` (pre-established compositor layer), `z-index: -1` (paints above button background but below inline text and icon, preserving WCAG AA contrast) - Add `.flash-active .reset-glow` rule: `opacity: 1; transition: none` for an instant full-brightness glow that appears synchronously on click - Add `.flash-out .reset-glow` rule: `opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.65s` for a smooth fade driven entirely on the compositor thread after reset completes - Remove old `@keyframes reset-flash` block that animated non-compositor-eligible properties (`background`, `border-color`, `box-shadow`, `color`) which froze when the JS main thread was blocked by `graph.reset()` src/app/js/menu/resetMenu.js - Apply `.flash-active` synchronously at the start of `resetGraph()` before any async work, so the compositor layer (pre-established via `will-change`) receives the animation immediately - Add `offsetWidth` read to force a style recalculation between class removal and re-addition, ensuring the CSS animation restarts cleanly on rapid re-clicks - Switch from single to double `requestAnimationFrame` to guarantee two full paint+commit cycles complete before `graph.reset()` starts; after Frame N+1 is committed the compositor holds an established animation state and can animate independently while the main thread is blocked - Wrap all heavy work (`graph.reset()`, module resets, `graph.updateStyle()`) inside the inner rAF callback - Replace the old single-rAF `.resetting` class approach with `.flash-out` toggled after work completes, triggering the CSS opacity transition on the pre-existing compositor layer of `.reset-glow` src/index.html - Add `` as the first child of `#reset-button` so its compositor layer (`will-change: opacity`) is always present from page load, with zero creation delay on click

  - Toggle drag state classes instead of setting cursor styles.

- `src/webvowl/js/rangeDragger.js`
  - Toggle drag state classes instead of setting cursor styles.

  - Apply shadow property colors through the shared custom-fill helper.

  - Verify light and dark background contrast classes.

User Experience Changes
- Prevent invalid viewport settings from producing NaN SVG transforms.
- Disable graph-dependent controls until ontology rendering completes.
- Keep ontology selection and Editing available after loading errors.
- Enable empty-ontology creation only while Editing is active.
- Create consecutive empty ontologies without reusing stale routes.
- Surface direct-input conversion failures through the loading state.

File Changes
- src/app/css/toolstyle.css
  - Remove unconditional pointer suppression from the create button.
  - Style toolbar, search, create, and zoom disabled states natively.
  - Restrict hover styles to enabled create and zoom controls.
- src/app/js/app.js
  - Refresh control availability after menu initialization.
  - Remove DOM-based empty-ontology route bookkeeping.
  - Mark parsed models ready after caching their ontology data.
- src/app/js/directInputModule.js
  - Initialize loading before parsing or converting direct input.
  - Accept only populated class arrays as successful JSON input.
  - Route conversion failures through graph loading-error handling.
- src/app/js/loadingModule.js
  - Replace the loading-success boolean with lifecycle state.
  - Apply lifecycle capabilities to graph-dependent controls.
  - Mark URL, conversion, and direct-input loading transitions.
  - Add explicit, uniquely routed empty-ontology creation.
- src/app/js/loadingModule.test.js
  - Verify direct creation and consecutive empty-ontology routes.
  - Verify numbering continues from an externally loaded route.
- src/app/js/menu/exportMenu.js
  - Export zoom settings as numbers instead of numeric strings.
- src/app/js/menu/ontologyMenu.js
  - Treat native disabled state as authoritative.
  - Delegate empty-ontology creation to the loading command.
  - Synchronize Editing-dependent controls during setup.
- src/app/js/menu/ontologyMenu.test.js
  - Verify enabled create actions invoke the loading command.
  - Verify disabled create actions remain inert.
- src/app/js/menu/searchMenu.js
  - Track search-menu and locate-result availability separately.
  - Disable search controls when graph interaction is unavailable.
  - Collapse and clear search presentation when disabling search.
- src/app/js/menu/searchMenu.test.js
  - Verify search and locate controls follow graph availability.
- src/app/js/menu/zoomSlider.js
  - Track graph-interaction availability for every zoom control.
  - Use native disabled state for buttons and the range input.
  - Guard pointer, touch, center, and continuous zoom actions.
- src/app/js/menu/zoomSlider.test.js
  - Verify every zoom control follows graph availability.
  - Verify zoom boundaries use native disabled state.
- src/app/js/ontologyLifecycle.js
  - Define ontology lifecycle states and their UI capabilities.
  - Expose parsed-model availability independently from readiness.
- src/app/js/ontologyLifecycle.test.js
  - Verify control capabilities across every lifecycle state.
  - Reject unknown lifecycle states.
- src/index.html
  - Initialize graph-dependent search, menu, and zoom controls
    as disabled.
- src/webvowl/js/graph.js
  - Normalize zoom and translation values inside the graph module.
  - Reject invalid viewport mutations and serialize finite transforms.
  - Guard relocation, centering, and animation geometry.
  - Mark rendering, ready, and error lifecycle transitions.
  - Initialize Editing from configuration.
  - Centralize Editing-dependent control synchronization.
- src/webvowl/js/graphViewport.test.js
  - Verify viewport normalization, clamping, and rejection.
  - Verify SVG transforms never serialize non-finite values.
- src/webvowl/js/parser.js
  - Import zoom and translation as one atomic viewport update.
  - Preserve automatic centering when viewport data is rejected.
- src/webvowl/js/parser.test.js
  - Verify atomic viewport imports.
  - Verify invalid viewport imports do not suppress centering.

  change.
- Keep offline ontology loading deterministic across supported
  platforms.
- Handle more complex ontologies.

goldenMaster.test.js
- Refactor the golden master compatibility suite:
  - Use explicit `node:` imports and centralize repeated constants.
  - Invoke Java with `execFileSync` and separate arguments to avoid
    shell-dependent quoting.
  - Map versioned ontology URLs to local fixture paths declaratively.
  - Increased limit of Djdk.xml.totalEntitySizeLimit java parameter
    to be able to handle larger ontologies
    such as Drammar_NunnaryScene_Optimized_Rules.owl
  - Add response and URL helpers for the offline `fetch` replacement.
  - Build `Map` and `Set` indexes to avoid repeated VOWL array scans.
  - Normalize annotations with sorted `Object.fromEntries` output.
  - Compare anonymous union references by their sorted members.
  - Reuse array-difference logic for subclass and disjoint checks.
  - Replace mutable comparison flags with declarative `every` checks.
  - Use optional chaining, nullish defaults, `Object.hasOwn`, and
    `for...of` loops throughout the test.
  - Preserve diagnostics, expected differences, assertions, and timeout
    behavior while improving readability and maintainability.

message.body:
User Experience Changes:
- The Manchester parser now natively parses all edge-case language features, legacy characteristics, datatype facets, property chains, and syntactic sugars to achieve full 1-for-1 parity with the Java OWLAPI `ManchesterOWLSyntax` implementation.

src/owl2vowl/js/manchesterSyntaxParser.js
- Correct `Facts:` and `Annotations:` parsers to correctly process property-value assignments rather than class expressions, translating them to property assertions (`owl:NegativePropertyAssertion` and `owl:AnnotationProperty`).
- Introduce datatype facet boundary parsing (`[` and `]`) in the Lexer to support constrained restrictions (e.g., `length`, `pattern`, `minInclusive`, `maxInclusive`), mapping to `owl:withRestrictions` RDF lists.
- Support `ValuePartition:`, `DisjointUnionOf:`, and `HasKey:` constructs with list serialization targeting `owl:disjointUnionOf` and `owl:hasKey`.
- Implement inverse syntaxes `SuperClassOf:`, `SuperPropertyOf:`, and `Inverses:`, inverting subjects and properties respectively to maintain ontological integrity.
- Expand characteristics to process `Irreflexive`, `Asymmetric`, and the legacy `AntiSymmetric` OWL property constraints.
- Process `Self` property fillers (`owl:hasSelf`), `onlysome` compound restrictions (mapping to `someValuesFrom` intersecting `allValuesFrom`), and `SubPropertyChain:` (`o`, `->`) logic (mapping to `owl:propertyChainAxiom`).

User Experience Changes:
- Resolves an application freeze that occurred when uploading certain valid Manchester syntax files containing mathematical constraints.
- Ensures highly accurate and compliant rendering of Manchester syntax files, ensuring feature parity with standard semantic tools.
- Users can now reliably load and render Native RDF/XML, Turtle, and OWL/XML files, resolving regressions where valid files containing stray periods caused unrecoverable parsing errors.

src/owl2vowl/js/importLoader.js:
- Add a robust fall-through conversion loop (`convertToRdfXmlFallback`) replicating the Java OWLAPI fallback pipeline natively inside the module. This attempts conversion across multiple format parsers iteratively to handle cases where format sniffing fails or is uncertain, enforcing strict syntax validations on unexpected format boundaries.
- Add detection and conversion wrappers to ensure remote imported files are universally fetched and translated on the fly into `DOMParser` compliant RDF/XML.

src/owl2vowl/js/index.js:
- Refactor the hardcoded parser selection branches to leverage the unified `convertToRdfXmlFallback` from `importLoader.js`, solving greedy regex regressions while matching the OWLAPI iterative behavior.

src/owl2vowl/js/manchesterSyntaxParser.js:
- Update `parseDatatypeFacets` to reconstruct `>=` and `<=` from separate `>`/`<` and `=` tokens generated by the lexer.
- Add an `|EOF|` termination check to the `parseDatatypeFacets` loop to prevent unbounded recursion on truncated strings.
- Re-map `this.parsePrimary` to `this.parseNonNary` within `parseRestriction` to prevent runtime TypeErrors during nested restriction parsing.
- Refine RDF node creation logic within `parseFact` to resolve object IRIs strictly against `getURI()` rather than preserving raw AST literal nodes.
- Ensure strict adherence to the Java OWLAPI AST by renaming `Individual` to `NamedIndividual` during `parseSwrlArgument` and `OneOf` expression evaluation.
- Differentiate between `owl:targetIndividual` and `owl:targetValue` when serializing negative property assertions based on whether the target is an object or literal.

crashes or hanging loading screens, as the parsing pipeline now streams
data efficiently and fails fast on unsupported formats. When loading

German labels) now correctly display in the application instead of being
silently dropped.

    catch xmldom ParseErrors.

fix(parsers): Implement Java parser sequence and stream-based lexers

User Experience Changes

Users uploading large (2MB+) ontologies will no longer experience browser
crashes or hanging loading screens, as the parsing pipeline now streams
data efficiently and fails fast on unsupported formats. When loading
Manchester Syntax files, multi-language annotations (e.g., English and
German labels) now correctly display in the application instead of being
silently dropped.

* src/owl2vowl/js/functionalSyntaxParser.js
  - Add fail-fast streaming lexer and recursive descent parser for OWL
    Functional Syntax to match Java OWLAPI output.

* src/owl2vowl/js/functionalSyntaxParser.test.js
  - Add comprehensive unit tests validating parser behaviour.

* src/owl2vowl/js/importLoader.js
  - Enforce strict Java OWLAPI parser priority sequence for format
    fallback.
  - Wrap native RDF/XML format validation in try/catch to correctly
    catch xmldom ParseErrors.
  - Implement OWL/XML format exclusion in the early-return path.
  - Implement format sniff guards for Manchester Syntax.

* src/owl2vowl/js/importLoader.test.js
  - Add fallback sequence unit test verifying sequential parser fallthrough.

* src/owl2vowl/js/manchesterSyntaxParser.js
  - Convert eager lexer tokenizer to memory-efficient ES6 generators.
  - Fix language-tag literal parsing by matching exact Java lexer
    consumption sequence.

* src/owl2vowl/js/owlXmlParser.js
  - Suppress native DOMParser error logging to rely exclusively on standard
    parsererror inspection.

message.body:
User Experience Changes

Users will notice clearer terminology in the
filter panel (e.g., "Datatype properties" instead of "Datatypes",
"Solitary subclasses" instead of "Subclass relationships", and
"Class disjointness" instead of "Disjoint with relationships").
Additionally, the vertical separator in the main toolbar has been slightly
thickened (from 1px to 4px) and rounded, ensuring it remains visible on
all screens without collapsing on mobile devices. The pause button's active
state now matches the exact amber highlight color of other active menu items,
providing a more cohesive visual experience.

* src/index.html
  - Update UI filter labels for datatypes, subclasses, and disjointness
    to use more accurate terminology.

* src/app/css/toolstyle.css
  - Introduce --theme-color-accent CSS variable for consistent highlights
    and active states across all toolbar and sidebar buttons.
  - Refactor #pause-button.paused to use var(--theme-color-accent) and
    color-mix for hover states, removing redundant borders.
  - Refactor all hardcoded #d90 instances across the codebase to use
    the new --theme-color-accent variable.
  - Fix .nav-separator flex-shrink collapsing on mobile and improve its
    visibility by increasing width to 4px with rounded border-radius.
  - Increase .nav-separator rule specificity to override #menuElementContainer
    children height inheritance.

* src/app/css/toolstyle.test.js
  - Update test assertions to validate new CSS variables and hover
    color-mix values.

message.body:
The SVG export in src/app/js/menu/svgExportStyles.js now clones the
live SVG and runs window.getComputedStyle() to natively inline all
currently applied CSS properties directly onto the SVG elements.

This dynamic approach entirely supersedes the old manual workflow,
which relied on static CSS parsing to inject hardcoded D3 rules.
Because getComputedStyle handles styling at runtime (including dynamic
states missed by static parsers), maintaining a static CSS-to-D3 script
is redundant and introduces unnecessary build complexity.

    queries

    ontology state

       compatibility gate

       handoff

     - Mark Phase 3 complete and keep Phase 4 behind the checkpoint gate
  5. `docs/owlapi-js/migration/parser-migration-playbook.md`

structural mapping, browser and Node XML adapters, and strict resource
policies. Register the parser ahead of textual formats, pin the Node
fallback, govern the single known Java difference, and close the phase
with conformance, differential, resource, and performance evidence.

File Changes:
  1. `docs/owlapi-js/migration/lessons/006-development-integration.md`
     - Rewrite finding `M7-008` from an open regression deferred to
       Phase 8 into a benchmark-isolation lesson, because the original
       measurement was taken while the same session ran repeated
       full-text scans over a 44 MB file and the contention roughly
       doubled the reported wall times
     - Change its disposition from `LOCAL_PHASE_FOLLOW_UP` to
       `PLAYBOOK_UPDATE` now that no follow-up work remains
     - Record the three reasoning errors that turned contaminated data
       into a finding, and the isolated repeat, scaling check and
       inter-signal arithmetic that disproved it
     - Report no unresolved questions and no unresolved blockers, and
       state that Phase 8 inherits no performance debt
  2. `docs/owlapi-js/migration/migration-status.md`
     - State that Phase 7 closes with no deferred items and restore the
       Phase 8 blocker to the acceptance gate alone
  3. `docs/owlapi-js/migration/parser-migration-playbook.md`
     - Require benchmark runs to be serialized against all other work
     - Require an isolated repeat, a scaling check, and an inter-signal
       arithmetic check before recording any threshold breach, and warn
       that a tight run-to-run spread shows sustained conditions rather
       than clean ones
     - Drop the instruction to resolve `M7-008` during Phase 8
  4. `docs/owlapi-js/performance/baseline.md`
     - Replace the Phase 7 signals with measurements taken on an idle
       machine and note the isolation requirement
     - Report both paired RDF/XML signals within the unchanged 20%
       threshold, the end-to-end signal now measuring 1.86% below its
       accepted baseline rather than 85.75% above it
     - Remove the open-regression analysis and the bypass attribution
       table that rested on the contaminated measurement
     - Add the arithmetic consistency check relating the three accepted
       signals to each other

       and independent corroboration of any threshold breach, after a

     - Require the benchmark environment record to capture the machine's
       concurrent-load state, since every dimension section 20.6
       previously named is a static property of the environment
     - Forbid running a release-gated benchmark in the background
       alongside other work, and recommend an executable pre-flight
       check
     - State that repeated measurement and aggregation do not protect
       against sustained interference, and that a tight run-to-run
       spread shows sustained conditions rather than clean ones
     - Require independent corroboration of a threshold breach before it
       is recorded as a finding, regression or gate failure
     - Clarify that the re-run prohibition forbids selecting a
       favourable sample and not discarding a demonstrably invalid
       measurement

File Changes:
  1. `docs/adr/0004-vowl-specification-as-correctness-authority.md`
     - Propose adopting the VOWL 2.0 specification as the correctness
       authority for visualization output, because every existing check
       compares implementations to each other and cannot detect an error
       the reference implementation itself makes
     - Separate three authorities: W3C for OWL semantics, the VOWL

message.body:
File Changes:
  1. `docs/adr/0004-vowl-specification-as-correctness-authority.md`
     - State that `owlapi-js` follows the W3C OWL 2 specifications and
       must contain no VOWL concept, and that the VOWL specification
       governs `VOWLBuilder` on the WebVOWL side of the seam, because an
       earlier draft attributed the VOWL notation to the library itself
       and so described the coupling the extraction exists to prevent
     - Withdraw the claim that the specification excludes
       `owl:someValuesFrom` and `owl:allValuesFrom` from the
       visualization; in full context that passage groups them with
       `owl:Restriction` and `owl:onProperty` as containers that receive
       no graphical element of their own, and includes `rdfs:comment`,
       which WebVOWL displays
     - Record that no OWL2VOWL divergence from the specification has
       been established and that the register therefore starts empty
     - Require a divergence to quote its deciding passage in surrounding
       context, since the withdrawn claim came from a single grepped
       sentence
     - Defer specification conformance rather than requiring it, so the
       engine swap stays transparent to end users, and escalate any
       user-visible conflict to the repository owner
  2. `src/owlapi-js/coreIsolation.architecture.test.js`
     - Assert that no shipped module under `src/owlapi-js/` mentions
       VOWL and that none imports from outside the library tree, closing
       a boundary that was guarded only in the opposite direction
     - Exempt governance and architecture tests, which name VOWL because
       they validate repository-wide artifacts rather than the library

User Experience Changes:
  - Show the diagram when an imported ontology cannot be reached,
    instead of failing the whole file

File Changes:
  1. `package.json`
     - Exclude the retained legacy differential suite from `npm test`,
       which gates deployment and must not run the pipeline the Phase 8
       cutover replaced
     - Pin `/node_modules/` explicitly, since `testPathIgnorePatterns`
       replaces jest's default rather than extending it
     - Add `test:legacy` so the retained suite stays runnable on demand
  2. `src/owl2vowl/js/index.js`
     - Handle an unreachable import as a diagnostic in
       `loadWithImports`, matching the single-document entry and the
       pinned oracle
  3. `src/owl2vowl/js/index.test.js`
     - Cover a document whose import returns 404, which previously
       aborted the entire load
  4. `src/owl2vowl/test/differential.test.js`
     - Record why the suite is retained and how to run it
     - Use the shared projection and comparison rather than private
       copies, so both differentials measure the same dimensions
  5. `src/owl2vowl/test/productionCorpus.test.js`
     - Gate `loadWithImports` as well, since that is the entry the
       application calls and it was previously untested
     - Assert that the two documents whose import closures are Turtle
       are refused by the closure-resolving entry until Phase 9
  6. `src/owl2vowl/test/vowlDifferential.js`
     - Extract the semantic projection and seven-dimension comparison
       shared by both corpus differentials
     - Report per-dimension detail alongside each verdict, so a
       difference can be described rather than only counted
     - Resolve imports exactly as the production resolver does, rather
       than through the legacy basename fallback
     - Return 404 for an unresolvable import rather than substituting an
       empty ontology, which would change what is compared
  7. `src/testRunnerScope.architecture.test.js`
     - Assert the default run omits only the retained suite, keeping the
       six sibling suites whose names also contain "differential"
     - Assert the default run never reaches into `node_modules`
     - Assert the retained suite stays discoverable and scripted

User Experience Changes:
  - Show properties from vocabularies that type them only as
    rdf:Property, such as DOAP, which previously drew none
  - Keep every language of a label rather than only the last one read
  - Mark an entity as external only when it belongs to another
    ontology, not merely a deeper namespace
  - Produce the same diagram on every machine, independent of the
    system locale

File Changes:
  1. `docs/adr/0005-cross-category-property-punning.md`
     - Amend the decision so evidence stated about a property decides
       its category, demoting the fixed precedence to a fallback
     - Record why document order is disqualified: RDF is unordered, so
       the same ontology answers differently per serialisation
     - Scope compatible-mode recovery to the document and leave
       strict-mode conformance at the specification's closure scope
  2. `docs/owlapi-js/implementation-plan.md`
     - Add section 22.2.1 governing reference implementations other
       than OWLAPI, since VOWLBuilder's reference was ungoverned
     - Set out the consult-and-derive procedure, the escalation order
       and the requirement to record refuted findings
     - Record two observed failure modes: reading one method as the
       algorithm, and mistaking a harness asymmetry for an engine
       difference
  3. `docs/owlapi-js/provenance/provenance.json`
     - Pin OWL2VOWL as a second reference implementation with its
       revision, licence and consult-only use
     - Record two compatibility research activities, both refuted and
       both without production effect

     - Cover annotation identifiers and the namespace that keeps a
       shared local name unambiguous

     - Cover the built-in node labels and both halves of the external
       rule, including the OWL 2 datatype map exemption

User Experience Changes:
  - Preserve annotations that were previously discarded when an
    ontology described one of its own descriptions
  - Show every domain an ontology states for a relationship rather
    than an arbitrary one of them
  - Show the label an ontology marks as preferred instead of picking
    between competing labels alphabetically
  - Mark deprecated classes and properties as deprecated
  - Remove connections that stated nothing, such as links to the
    generic top-level concept every class already belongs to
  - Draw shared elements beside each item that uses them, so a single
    element no longer becomes a hub that dominates the layout
  - Show a cardinality figure on a relationship's existing connection
    instead of adding a duplicate connection beside it

File Changes:
  1. `docs/adr/0005-cross-category-property-punning.md`
     - Add a second amendment refusing a sub-property statement
       whose two ends belong to different property categories,
       which had promoted a built-in annotation property to an
       object property
     - Record the annotation-crossing rule in the implementation map
  2. `docs/adr/0006-restriction-edges-as-a-documented-departure.md`
     - Record that restriction edges are kept as a departure from
       VOWL 2 rather than as conformance, with benchmark evidence
       showing the specification's own reference implementation
       drew none
     - Establish the governing rule for the area: follow the
       specification where it speaks and the oracle where it is
       silent
  3. `docs/adr/0007-axiom-annotations-nest-on-the-annotation.md`
     - Record that an axiom's annotations nest on the annotation
       they describe rather than being promoted to the entity,
       which had asserted what the ontology does not say
     - Record the ten reifications of structural axioms that have
       no home under the rule
  4. `docs/adr/README.md`
     - Index the two new decision records
  5. `docs/owlapi-js/compatibility/production-corpus-differences.json`
     - Add the per-dimension register of every remaining difference
       from the pinned oracle, with the policy that a specification
       overrides the oracle where the two conflict
  6. `docs/owlapi-js/conformance/suites.json`
     - Record the authors' own publication as a corroborating
       source, with all three superseding versions hashed against
       the published files
     - Record the evidence settling whether VOWL 2 draws
       restriction edges
  7. `docs/owlapi-js/migration/lessons/007-production-cutover.md`
     - Rewrite the outstanding-gate section to record how the
       production differential gate is now met
     - Add findings M8-007 through M8-010 covering differential
       blind spots, format against semantic authority, pipelines
       hiding failures, and inputs drifting apart
  8. `docs/owlapi-js/migration/migration-status.md`
     - Move Phase 8 from blocked to gate met
     - Reconcile the deferred fixture regeneration with the single
       fixture that was regenerated, and record that the namespace
       exclusion criterion misses partial coverage
  9. `docs/owlapi-js/migration/parser-migration-playbook.md`
     - Institutionalize running verification commands whole,
       because a pipeline reports its last command's exit status
     - Institutionalize treating a reference output as a function
       of both an input and an oracle version
     - Institutionalize per-dimension justification and stating
       what a differential's dimensions cannot see
  10. `docs/owlapi-js/provenance/provenance.json`
     - Record the research establishing what the instances count
       actually counts
  11. `src/owl2vowl/js/vowlBuilder.annotations.test.js`
     - Cover nesting an axiom's annotations on the annotation they
       describe, and preferring a stated preferred label
  12. `src/owl2vowl/js/vowlBuilder.classExpressions.test.js`
     - Cover cardinality as a label on the existing arrow, and
       restrictions whose filler has no node to point at
  13. `src/owl2vowl/js/vowlBuilder.domains.test.js`
     - Cover joining several stated domains into their
       intersection rather than keeping only one
  14. `src/owl2vowl/js/vowlBuilder.instances.test.js`
     - Cover the instances count reflecting class-and-individual
       punning rather than the number of members
  15. `src/owl2vowl/js/vowlBuilder.js`
     - Join several stated domain or range axioms into the
       intersection OWL 2 reads them as, instead of keeping
       whichever was processed last and orphaning the rest
     - Nest an axiom's annotations on the annotation item they
       describe rather than promoting them to the entity
     - Apply the VOWL 2 splitting rules so generic elements are
       drawn once per element that links to them
     - Label a cardinality on the property's existing arrow and
       drop the duplicate edge it would otherwise add
     - Draw no edge where the target has no node of its own, and
       no subclass edge to the top concept
     - Share endpoints across an inverse pair, and mark deprecation
     - Prefer a stated preferred label over alphabetical order
  16. `src/owl2vowl/js/vowlBuilder.splitting.test.js`
     - Cover the splitting rules for datatypes, literals and the
       top concept, including independence from axiom order
  17. `src/owl2vowl/js/vowlBuilder.subclasses.test.js`
     - Cover suppressing a subclass edge to the top concept while
       keeping an ordinary one
  18. `src/owl2vowl/js/vowlBuilder.test.js`
     - Resolve endpoints through their identifiers, because
       splitting means an identifier no longer names one node
     - Update the instances expectation to the punning definition
  19. `src/owl2vowl/test/fixtures/java-reference-outputs/skos.rdf.java.json`
     - Regenerate against the same pinned oracle version after the
       corpus copy of SKOS was replaced with the canonical document
  20. `src/owl2vowl/test/productionDifferential.test.js`
     - Add the gate comparing the production entry against the
       pinned oracle over the non-Turtle corpus, one test per
       document
     - Fail on a justification for a dimension that no longer
       differs, so the register cannot accumulate stale
       explanations
  21. `src/owl2vowl/test/vowlBuilder.differential.test.js`
     - Remove an unlinked top-concept node from the legacy
       snapshot before comparing, as a governed divergence
  22. `src/owl2vowl/test/vowlDifferential.js`
     - Collect every edge an identifier carries and match pairwise
       against unused candidates, so ordering cannot decide the
       verdict
     - Withhold named imports so both sides convert the same
       closure
  23. `src/owl2vowl/test/vowlDifferential.test.js`
     - Cover the widened comparator, including that an edge one
       side draws and the other does not still counts as a
       difference
  24. `src/owlapi-js/rdf/crossCategorySubProperty.test.js`
     - Cover refusing a sub-property statement that crosses the
       annotation category, in both parsing modes
  25. `src/owlapi-js/rdf/rdfToOwlTranslator.axioms.test.js`
     - Assert that no object sub-property axiom is built for a
       category-crossing statement
  26. `src/owlapi-js/rdf/rdfToOwlTranslator.js`
     - Declare undeclared annotation properties during the
       declaration phase, so a reification can still find the
       assertion it annotates
     - Recover a class typed with the RDFS spelling, and stop
       reading the RDF and RDFS typing terms as class assertions
     - Refuse a sub-property statement crossing the annotation
       category, recording it as a diagnostic
  27. `src/owlapi-js/rdf/rdfTypingVocabularyAssertion.test.js`
     - Cover the typing vocabulary no longer becoming a class, and
       the RDFS class declaration being recovered
  28. `src/owlapi-js/rdf/undeclaredAnnotation.test.js`
     - Cover recovering undeclared annotation properties early
       enough for a reification to attach to them
